text: Cats like milk. Cats drink milk every day.
Dogs like bones. Dogs chew bones happily.
Birds fly in the sky. Birds have wings.
Fish swim in water. Fish live in the sea.
Lions roar loudly. Lions are kings.
Bees make honey. Bees live in hives.
Cows give milk. Cows eat grass.
Monkeys like bananas. Monkeys climb trees.
Frogs jump high. Frogs live near ponds.
Owls see at night. Owls are wise birds.
